title: LETHE：一种自指涉的GAN启发式音频处理架构
summary: LETHE是一种在SuperCollider中实现的自指涉音频系统，采用GAN形式但无外部数据。通过3x3混合矩阵和延迟线，利用判别器与随机优化器交互演化参数，实现自适应闭环声音生成。实验表明主动生成器对参数演化至关重要。
summary_en: LETHE is a self-referential audio system in SuperCollider adopting GAN-like closed-loop without external data. A 3x3 mixing matrix with delay lines evolves via discriminator and random optimizer, enabling adaptive sonic outcomes. Active generator is essential for parameter evolution.
